propositions: Four code-review criteria must be flipped from advisory to blocking based on code-v3 calibration: api-compat@0.51, deletion-impact@0.60, regression@0.54, and error-handling@0.50, each with validity≥0.83 and operator approval.

The approved blocking set must expand from 3 members (secret-detection, high-critical-security, security) to exactly 7 members including the four flipped criteria, enforced by governance-pin tests to prevent unapproved additions.
regression and error-handling must be added as new base-reviewer dimension entries in criteria_routing.json where only posture, threshold, and blocking_enabled fields are consulted by threshold_for.

Three governance tests (test_impact_model_versioning.py, test_code_review_ws2.py, test_code_review_deletion_impact.py) must be updated to assert the new 7-member blocking set and pass locally and in CI.
